CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization in the text.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), an access/organization field (origin) and separate content entries are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content items (color-labeled coordinate sets) with attribute labels.

D.rationale: The text separates identified content (coordinate assignments) from an explicit origin/access status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented/organized (grid orientation) and supplies per-item origin/access metadata.
